Definition: from the same as G4008; an extremity:--end, ut-(ter-)most part.
BiblicalUsage: Peras is an end, an extremity, the far edge. An oath is an end of all strife, and the queen of the south came from the utmost parts of the earth to hear the wisdom of Solomon.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that God sets the ends of things: an oath ends strife, and the earth's far edge is no distance from His wisdom.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
